title: Beyonce 01
name: beyonce-01
arc:
A Beyonce hip-driven groove with the arms held out. Weight stays centred while the arms work at chest-to-shoulder height out to the side, elbows opening and closing, peaking at shoulder height at frames 6 and 13; the weight moves over the character-left foot at frame 14.

The hips carry the rhythm; keep the arms out and framing the body. Pingpong: frames 0 and 20 are grounded turnarounds.

frames.cue: Weight centred over both feet. legs straight. on the balls of both feet, heels lifted. character-left arm at chest height, elbow slightly bent, out to the side. character-right arm low by the hip, elbow straight, by the side. torso upright. hips turned character-left against the shoulders. head forward.
